title: no claude on PATH is a warning, not a failure, when codex, opencode or pi is there
source: intended: harness adapters for codex, opencode and pi (v0.3); found by review of INSTALL.md, whose doctor step failed on a machine without Claude Code
intent: INTENDED behavior. A build may name `harness: codex`, `opencode` or `pi`, so a machine without Claude Code can launch workers. With no `claude` on PATH and another harness there, doctor prints `warn claude: claude is not on PATH; builds with harness: claude cannot launch here (found: <names>)` and does not fail on it. With no harness at all it still fails (doctor/missing-claude).

stdout.regex: (?m)^warn claude: claude is not on PATH; builds with harness: claude cannot launch here \(found: pi\)$
